主要内容: BASF SE, the world’s largest chemical company, issued a profit warning, signaling a weakening global economy. The company stated that slowing markets across various sectors, including cars and crops, along with the impact of the U.S.-China trade war, could cut profits by 30% this year. BASF, which produces plastics, pesticides, and lubricant additives, saw its stock drop the most in two months, leading chemical peers lower. Given its extensive supply chain across industries such as autos, consumer products, and computer chips, investors are now questioning the outlook for other sectors during the upcoming earnings season.
